name: brdcomp-radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: An exclusive selection group for choosing one option from a list, with labels and helper text.

examples.title: Radio options
examples.code:
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group"

<RadioGroup defaultValue="a">
  <RadioGroupItem value="a" label="Option A" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="b" label="Option B" />
</RadioGroup>
